description: REVISED BY ORCHESTRATOR (Jay's decision, supersedes plan item 5 / decision D3): do NOT add --cascade-trainable-init. Instead, for each non-default m11 width (d12h, d12hs, fr50) build RANDOM-WEIGHT cascade sources at that width: a level-4 run from scratch, then a level-2 run cascading from that level-4 source, each saving a checkpoint after (almost) no training. Weight values are irrelevant (memory/time only), and this way the frozen L4/L2 stages in the level-1 measurement ALSO have the narrower width, which is what the from-scratch retrain will look like. The level-1 grid configs then use the normal --cascade-from copy path unchanged (identical ModelConfig). Also keep the documentation of the EXISTING per-block width flags (--filters stem..L6, --decoder-widths D5..D1; svf_norm_act follows D1) instead of new width flags (TASK 2). FEAT-003's m11 script uses the sources built here.
steps: Find the cheapest way to produce a cascade-compatible source checkpoint with the production code path: preferred = main.py itself with the smallest run that writes a checkpoint the cascade loader accepts (e.g. --steps 1 (or 0 if main.py supports it and still saves), deform-only or rigid:1 ratio as allowed, small --group-size / --deform-group-size, --val-every 0, ckpt saved to ckpt/last or ckpt/best; check what path --cascade-from / _load_cascade_source expect and whether ckpt/last is accepted as the source prefix dir). The level-4 source must contain the deform decoder (--deform-decoder true) with the target --filters / --decoder-widths. The level-2 source is a level-2 main.py run with --cascade-from <random L4 source> (same widths, normal copy path) so its checkpoint contains the frozen_stage the level-1 FrozenChain needs. Only if main.py cannot do this cleanly, add a small helper (e.g. scripts/make_random_source.py) that builds the model via the same builders and writes config.json + checkpoint in exactly the layout main.py writes; prefer main.py.

Implement this as a reusable shell function / block for FEAT-003's slurm/m11_fp32_width_memory.sh (or a separate small script it calls): per width W in {d12h, d12hs, fr50}: results under $PROJ/scratch/m11/<job>/sources/{l4_W,l2_W}; skip if already present (resumable). Use the production flags that affect the ModelConfig and the stored frozen stage (AMP, --deform-decoder-dtype matching the grid line or whatever the cascade compatibility check requires: check whether deform_decoder_dtype is part of ModelConfig / the cascade check, and if it is, decide whether the source dtype must equal the trainable dtype; frozen stages are built in float32 regardless, per plan). Default-width L1 configs keep using the real m7_three_task_lncc / m8_level2_gradnorm sources.

Width documentation, no new flags: runtime/args.py module docstring bullet + --filters help ('6 widths: stem, L2..L6; the stem width = the full-resolution encoder stage') + --decoder-widths help ('D5..D1; D1 = full resolution, D2 = half resolution at level 1; svf_norm_act follows D1; do not pass the explicit default list 128,96,64,32,16 to a cascade from a default run: None != explicit list in config.json'). models/width_presets.py docstring: paragraph 'm11 grid widths (flag lines, not presets)': d12h = --decoder-widths 128,96,64,16,8; d12hs = --filters 16,64,128,192,256,384 --decoder-widths 128,96,64,16,8; fr50 = the fr50 preset. Do NOT add PRESETS entries (tests.test_memory_model enumerates PRESETS).

Local test (tests/test_main.py TestCascadeMain or a new small test): with overfit-synthetic + TINY_ARGS but narrower --filters/--decoder-widths, build a random level-4 source with the chosen minimal main.py invocation, then a level-2 cascade from it, then a level-1 (or second level-2 if level 1 is not available locally) cascade from the level-2 source; all exit rc in (0, 1) and config.json shows init_weights mode as for a normal cascade; tf.train.list_variables of the level-2 source has 'frozen_stage/' keys. Keep it cheap (local 6 GB cap).
Run the targeted tests, then record in findings the exact source-building commands, the width flag lines, and that no new CLI flag was added.
acceptance_criteria: No --cascade-trainable-init flag; cascade code paths unchanged (existing tests.test_cascade / tests.test_main cascade tests pass unchanged)
A documented, tested minimal main.py recipe builds random level-4 and level-2 sources at a non-default width that a level-1 cascade accepts via the normal --cascade-from path
Width usage is documented in runtime/args.py and models/width_presets.py; no new width flags or presets

wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/.agents/tmp/fp32w_py38.sh   -> OK (main.py --help without TF)
findings: DONE, not committed. NO new CLI flag (no --cascade-trainable-init, no width flags, no PRESETS entries); main.py / runtime/checkpoint.py / models/cascade.py cascade code unchanged. RECIPE (production main.py, no helper .py needed): a run with --steps 1 --ckpt-every 0 --val-every 0 writes exactly one ckpt/last save at the end of fit() (fit saves iff final > start, so --steps 0 would save nothing); C.load_cascade_source accepts the directory <run>/ckpt/last (resolve_checkpoint -> latest prefix, config.json at <run>/config.json). ModelConfig has no task-dependent field, so the sources train rigid-only (cheapest) with --deform-decoder true; AMP, --deform-decoder-dtype, --gradient-checkpointing, --lean-sampler, --split-group-conv, group sizes and seed are NOT ModelConfig fields and need not match the grid lines (frozen stages are rebuilt in float32 from the source config, D2), so sources run float32, dtype 'policy'. Exact source commands (cluster, inside singularity exec --nv -B /scratch -B /autofs -B /cluster -B /space -B /vast $SIF, cwd $REPO): `python main.py --data $DATA --results $SOURCES_DIR --run-name l4_W --resume false --level 4 --task-ratio rigid:1 --deform-decoder true --group-size 4 --steps 1 --warmup-steps 0 --val-every 0 --ckpt-every 0 --val-png false --log-every 1 --log-backend jsonl --num-threads ${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-3} --prefetch 1 <W flags>` then the same with `--run-name l2_W --level 2 ... --cascade-from $SOURCES_DIR/l4_W/ckpt/last`. Width flag lines: default = none; d12h = --decoder-widths 128,96,64,16,8; d12hs = --filters 16,64,128,192,256,384 --decoder-widths 128,96,64,16,8; fr50 = --filters 16,32,128,192,256,384 --decoder-widths 128,96,64,16,8. FOR FEAT-003: new file slurm/m11_random_sources.sh (no SBATCH header, ASCII/LF; FEAT-003 must `source "$REPO/slurm/m11_random_sources.sh"` (sourcing sets no shell options and runs nothing) after setting DATA, SIF, SOURCES_DIR=$OUT_DIR/sources (= $PROJ/scratch/m11/<job>/sources), optional SOURCE_WIDTHS (default 'd12h d12hs fr50'), SOURCE_N (4), SOURCE_TIMEOUT (1200 s per run), and after the TMPDIR/SINGULARITYENV_* exports + cd $REPO. Functions: `m11_width_args W` (prints W's flags, nothing for default, rc 2 + stderr for unknown; reuse it for the grid lines), `m11_source_cmd LEVEL W` (sets array M11_CMD=(python main.py ...)), `m11_source_ok DIR` (0 iff DIR/config.json and DIR/ckpt/last/checkpoint exist), `m11_build_sources` (per width l4_W then l2_W; skips present sources = resumable; rm -rf of a partial dir before a rebuild; l2_W not run (rc -2) if l4_W is missing; one `timeout $SOURCE_TIMEOUT singularity exec ... > $SOURCES_DIR/<name>.log 2>&1 </dev/null` per source; tail -n 5 on failure; BGR_DRY_RUN=1 prints `SOURCE <name>: python main.py ...` lines (order l4_d12h l2_d12h l4_d12hs l2_d12hs l4_fr50 l2_fr50) and touches nothing; returns 2 only on an unknown width, else 0). Status file $SOURCES_DIR/status.tsv, tab-separated header `name level widths rc ok elapsed_s log` (ok 1 iff m11_source_ok after the run). Grid line sources: L2 non-default lines `--cascade-from $SOURCES_DIR/l4_W/ckpt/last`, L1 non-default lines `--cascade-from $SOURCES_DIR/l2_W/ckpt/last`; skip a width's grid lines when `m11_source_ok $SOURCES_DIR/l2_W` (L1) / `.../l4_W` (L2) fails. Standalone `bash slurm/m11_random_sources.sh` also works (SOURCES_DIR default $PROJ/scratch/m11/<job>/sources, validates SOURCE_WIDTHS in {d12h,d12hs,fr50}, SOURCE_N >= 2, SOURCE_TIMEOUT >= 1 -> exit 2; exit 1 if any l2_W missing). Time estimate (header, not measured): l4 ~2-3 min, l2 ~4-6 min -> ~6-9 min per width, ~20-25 min for 3 widths; add to the m11 budget. Docs: runtime/args.py module docstring bullet 'per-block widths' + --filters help (6 values stem, L2..L6; stem = full-res encoder stage; presets in models/width_presets.py) + --decoder-widths help (D5..D1; D1 full res, D2 half res at L1; SVF norm-act follows D1; explicit default list != None caveat); models/width_presets.py docstring paragraph 'm11 grid widths (flag lines, not presets)'. Tests: tests/test_main.py TestCascadeMain.test_random_width_sources_chain (overfit-synthetic, TINY_ARGS + --filters 4,16,16,16,16,16 --decoder-widths 8,8,8,4,4, the recipe flags with --overfit-max-steps 1: level 4 -> level 2 cascade -> level 1 cascade (--amp true --split-group-conv true, N 2); rc in (0,1); l2 ckpt/last has frozen_stage/ keys; l2 and l1 config.json init_weights via cascade mode full n_fresh_vars 0, cross_level [4,2] / [2,1], cascade source_step 1, narrow widths in model_config; l1 cascade stages [4,2] origin_step [1,1]) - PASSED. tests/test_slurm_scripts.py: constants M11SRC, M11_SOURCE_ENV; class TestM11Sources (static ASCII/no CR/no forbidden account/no SBATCH/no flag name, bash -n; dry-run order + every argv parses with runtime.args and its ModelConfig (seed aside) equals the deform:1 grid config of that width and differs from default; parse of --cascade-trainable-init fails; stub run (4 calls, status rows, resume = 0 calls); failed l4 -> l2 rc -2, exit 1; invalid settings exit 2; sourced functions). tests/run_tests_wsl.sh: slurm/m11_random_sources.sh added to the bash -n loop. Verification: `wsl -d Ubuntu bash -c "tr -d '\r' < .../.agents/tmp/fp32w_tests.sh > /tmp/fp32w_tests.sh; bash /tmp/fp32w_tests.sh tests.test_cascade tests.test_main tests.test_runtime_infra tests.test_width_presets_tf"` -> all exit 0: test_cascade 46 OK (3171 s), test_main 41 OK (4632 s), test_runtime_infra 35 OK (1 skip dllogger), test_width_presets_tf 2 OK. fp32w_py38.sh -> py_compile + ast 3.8 OK (87 files), bash -n slurm/*.sh OK incl. m11_random_sources.sh, main.py --help OK, TF-free tests 71 OK without TF.
